summary: Evaluates a 3-axis quadratic form: for each axis, selects one of two 3-element rows of the coefficient matrix `this` based on the sign of the input component a2[i], scales the row by a2[i]^2, and accumulates the result into a 3-element output copied to a4. Separately builds an anti-symmetric 3-element output a5 from coefficients this[18..20] scaled by a3[i]^2, negating each result when the corresponding a3 component is positive.

local_names.a2: 3-component input vector for the quadratic-form accumulator
local_names.a3: 3-component input vector for the anti-symmetric output
local_names.stiffness_rows: coefficient matrix `this`, addressed as rows of 3 doubles (rows 0/1, 2/3, 4/5 selected per axis)
local_names.damping_coeffs: this[18], this[19], this[20] used for the a5 output

operations.description: Per axis, compare each a2[i] component against the zero literal (global 0x0059E430) to select the coefficient row: axis 0 picks row 0 or 1, axis 1 picks row 2 or 3, axis 2 picks row 4 or 5.
Accumulate a4 output: per axis, scale the selected 3-element row by a2[i]*a2[i] and sum the three axis contributions into the 3-element accumulator (offsets 0, 1, 2 within the local double[3]).
Copy the 3-element accumulator (0x18 bytes, 3 doubles) into the a4 output array via qmemcpy.
Build a5 output: for each axis, a5[i] = this[18+i] * a3[i] * a3[i], then negate the stored value when a3[i] > 0.0, giving an anti-symmetric (sign-flipped) per-axis response.
